title: Dark Christmas
overview: Maria spends Christmas alone at home and begins to sense a strange presence. Disturbing events unfold, and she finds herself forced to hide while searching for the intruder. In a tense climax, Maria struggles to remain concealed, but never manages to catch a glimpse of the assailant's face. With death looming, she realizes she is utterly vulnerable to the unknown.
